ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Painting & Collage Creations. In this course we will learn how to create our own visual language as we examine color, composition, and content. Through the completion of four or five projects we will investigate and explore the uses of paint and traditional art materials along with techniques that include collage elements. This section for Chancellor's Scholars only; other students may only enroll with consent of instructor and the Campus Honors Program.
